comments: Approved. Confirms: (1) every locator listed MCP_VALIDATION_REQUIRED in TP-EC-12000-001-automation-design.md may be validated by Playwright MCP at PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION without a further design review, and (2) the eoRequestExport contract for TS-011 through -015 stays scaffolding-only (API_CONTRACT_UNVERIFIED) until observed and promoted to HUMAN_APPROVED by a human reviewer - this gate does not itself authorize treating that contract as authoritative.

itemDecisions.comment: Media Type section renders with Print to Paper default. UI, all locators MCP_VALIDATION_REQUIRED.
Save as Electronic File + required fields opens a checkbox-gated acknowledgement modal. UI, all locators MCP_VALIDATION_REQUIRED.
Confirming the acknowledgement modal closes both modals and creates the Work Queue item. UI. Writes a real Work Queue entry using fabricated requester/approver data.
Cancelling the acknowledgement modal leaves the Paper Out modal open with no Work Queue item created. UI.
UI Print to Paper, transaction level, determines Media Type Paper. UI.
UI Print to Paper, document level, determines Media Type Paper. UI.
UI Save as Electronic File, transaction level, determines Media Type Electronic. UI.
UI Save as Electronic File, document level, determines Media Type Electronic. UI.

API mediaType=PrintToPaper, transaction level, determines Media Type Paper. HYBRID, scaffoldingOnly - the API step reaches a state, the UI audit-trail assertion judges the AC. eoRequestExport remains API_CONTRACT_UNVERIFIED.
API mediaType=PrintToPaper, document level, determines Media Type Paper. HYBRID, same rationale as TS-011.
API mediaType=SaveAsElectronicFile, transaction level, determines Media Type Electronic. HYBRID, same rationale as TS-011.
API mediaType=SaveAsElectronicFile, document level, determines Media Type Electronic. HYBRID, same rationale as TS-011.
API call omitting mediaType entirely determines Media Type Electronic. HYBRID, same rationale as TS-011.
Media Type appears as Additional Information on the Submitted Paper Out event, cover page, audit trail and activity history report. UI.
Historical records are not retroactively updated with Media Type. UI.
Verify Paper Out modal's last checkbox reads the updated verbiage. UI.

Paper Out Request modal's right-side section borders are visually aligned. UI, MANUAL_ONLY per the approved plan - step definitions will exist for traceability but the assertion is expected to need human visual confirmation.
